description: Calculate profit, break-even sales/months and capacity from explicit user inputs. No tax or wage deduction; no predicted sales or prefilled Etsy fees.

currency.description: All input money amounts must already be in this currency; no conversion.

feeFixed.description: Explicit user-provided non-negative amount. Use zero only when the user confirms no cost.

feePercent.description: Explicit user-provided non-negative amount. Use zero only when the user confirms no cost.

investment.description: Explicit user-provided non-negative amount. Use zero only when the user confirms no cost.

labourMinutes.description: Minutes per item, explicitly provided by the user.

machineHours.description: Available machine hours per month; zero means capacity is unknown.

machineMinutes.description: Minutes per item, explicitly provided by the user.

material.description: Explicit user-provided non-negative amount. Use zero only when the user confirms no cost.

otherCost.description: Explicit user-provided non-negative amount. Use zero only when the user confirms no cost.

packaging.description: Explicit user-provided non-negative amount. Use zero only when the user confirms no cost.

perMonth.description: User sales assumption; zero means months cannot be estimated.

price.description: Explicit user-provided non-negative amount. Use zero only when the user confirms no cost.

runningCost.description: Explicit user-provided non-negative amount. Use zero only when the user confirms no cost.

name: calculate_etsy_payback
